glosses: to think someone deserves something, to witness or acknowledge someone's success or enjoyment without envy or grudge (usually referring to positive outcomes)

examples.text: De gunfactor zorgt ervoor dat mensen positief over je denken en je daardoor iets gunnen.
examples.translation: Likeability ensures that people think positively about you and because of that they will be okay with you getting something nice.
examples.english: Likeability ensures that people think positively about you and because of that they will be okay with you getting something nice.

examples.translation: He thinks you deserved that position. / He is happy for you that you got it.
examples.english: He thinks you deserved that position. / He is happy for you that you got it.

glosses: to award, to grant (of orders, tenders, etc.)

examples.text: De aanbesteder is niet verplicht de opdracht te gunnen.
examples.translation: The contracting party is not required to grant the order.
examples.english: The contracting party is not required to grant the order.

examples.text: Het bestuur besprak aan wie het de opdracht zou gunnen.
examples.translation: The managing board was discussing to whom they would award the order.
examples.english: The managing board was discussing to whom they would award the order.

glosses: to give, usually out of benevolence or grace; to grant

examples.text: De groote Koning gunde alle genoodigde gasten het genot van de bruyloft; tendien eynde liet hy ze noodigen.
examples.translation: The great King granted the pleasure of the wedding to all invited guests; to that end he let them be invited.
examples.english: The great King granted the pleasure of the wedding to all invited guests; to that end he let them be invited.
